gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold chief complaint only states 'headache.' Generated adds 'new onset,' 'left-sided,' and 'occipital,' which are not present in gold.
Timing 'yesterday mid-morning' is supported by gold (hpi-002), but specifying 'occipital' is additional detail; gold only says 'posterior.'
The 8/10 severity is supported by gold (hpi-003). However, 'intense' and 'throbbing' are not described in gold, so these descriptors are additions.

Gold ROS denies nausea, vomiting, visual disturbance/floaters, tingling, numbness, weakness, fever, neck stiffness. Generated denies 'nausea, vomiting, visual changes, neurological symptoms, fever, rash.' Some overlap (nausea, vomiting, fever) is supported, but 'rash' and broad 'neurological symptoms' are additional, and 'visual changes' is not exactly 'visual disturbance/floaters.' Overall best categorized as addition.
